verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships multiple official, npm-published SDKs: the MIT `playcanvas` engine (runtime probe shows v2.22.2 with ~48k weekly downloads), `@playcanvas/react`, `@playcanvas/web-components`, a documented Editor API, the `@playcanvas/splat-transform` library and PCUI. These are backed by `create-playcanvas` TypeScript scaffolds and AI-oriented aids such as llms.txt docs and PlayCanvas Skills for coding agents. missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec or official typed client for the REST API (OpenAPI probe returned 404), and little independent hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs.
